name: semantic_contrast_v0_3_lite_contradiction_vs_consistency_paired
description: v0.3-lite paired contrast for matching versus non-matching scene information.

consistent_information.text: A person reads that the meeting is in Room 204. The door label also says Room 204.
Someone checks a delivery note for a blue box. The box on the counter is blue.
A worker reads that the train leaves from Platform 6. The display above the track says Platform 6.
A visitor reads a ticket for Seat 12B. The chair marker also says Seat 12B.
Someone opens a recipe calling for two cups of rice. The measuring bowl contains two cups of rice.
A person reads that the package weighs five pounds. The scale display shows five pounds.
Someone checks a map showing the cafe on Pine Street. The storefront sign says Pine Street.
A clerk reads that the folder has a green tab. The folder on the desk has a green tab.
A person reads that the concert starts at seven. The posted schedule also says seven.
Someone reads that the locker code ends in 42. The written card also ends in 42.

contradictory_information.text: A person reads that the meeting is in Room 204. The door label says Room 317.
Someone checks a delivery note for a blue box. The box on the counter is red.
A worker reads that the train leaves from Platform 6. The display above the track says Platform 2.
A visitor reads a ticket for Seat 12B. The chair marker says Seat 9A.
Someone opens a recipe calling for two cups of rice. The measuring bowl contains four cups of rice.
A person reads that the package weighs five pounds. The scale display shows nine pounds.
Someone checks a map showing the cafe on Pine Street. The storefront sign says Cedar Street.
A clerk reads that the folder has a green tab. The folder on the desk has a yellow tab.
A person reads that the concert starts at seven. The posted schedule says nine.
Someone reads that the locker code ends in 42. The written card ends in 17.
